{{Recipe}}

This is a traditional Jewish dish.

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], separated
* 75 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 25 grams [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 small cooking [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]
* Grated [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]] of 1 [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]]
* 225 grams [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
* 50 grams [[Cookbook:Potato Flour|potato flour]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 190°C (375°F). 
# Grease a 1-litre [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the egg yolks and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy and pale in color.
# Very finely [[Cookbook:Grating|grate]] the carrot and apple, then squeeze out and discard all the liquid.  
# Mix the grated carrot, apple, orange rind, orange and lemon juice, and flour. 
# Combine the egg and carrot mixtures.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites until they are very stiff, and fold into carrot mixture.
# Spoon mixture into the greased casserole dish.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 35 minutes or until golden brown.
